limits: Only own immutable original D0 evidence and approved public design were examined. No source, plans, bridge, action, design or build settings were changed. No SDK, app launch, observer, preview or new screenshot command ran.

Qualitative review used original overlapping full-state sweeps for baseline, expanded and submitted. All selected native business facts were read for seven states per case/platform. A bottom sentinel alone was not treated as coverage.
iOS computed native font weight remains U in all seven states per case. Unsampled exact text/card colors are not invented.
Blocked disabled steps are not successful activation stimuli. Their empty callbacks do not establish a successful callback requirement; native disabled enablement is separately supported.
Android dispatch is semantic Compose OnClick in an attached view, not physical touch; parent scroll sampling does not establish OS gestures, navigation or lifecycle.

Public routes do not test deselection, arbitrary labels/data, changed availability combinations, RTL, every secondary callback, idempotence or all intermediate states. No pass is claimed for those unobserved paths.
Pixel support establishes only independently fixed sampling regions. Remaining canvas area and generic SwiftUI computed styling are not certified.
Six Android failed atoms share one clipping cause; the two original iOS machine failures are duplicates of original typed results. Counts are not independent bug totals.
No prior machine failure or generated bound result was erased or rewritten. All four bound requests succeeded without schema rejection.
command_and_activity_record: Read exact assigned review prompt, then immediately wrote actual phase start.
Read assigned atomic-review schema; inspected only own original observations, state coverage, native facts, reports, catalogs and check logs.
Created contact sheets from original PNG viewport bands only; original indices/state labels are preserved in contact-manifest.json.
Viewed twelve full-sweep contact sheets plus original raw PNGs to confirm Android disclosure clipping and original iOS header content.
Compared first contact-sheet viewport bands to original PNG crops with ImageChops; equality established.
Executed exactly four assigned review_contract.py review requests; all command argv, start/end Unix times, logs and exit codes are preserved in bound-commands.json.
Read original production disabled/disclosure source lines solely for cause attribution; verified production and plan hashes against sealed originals.
